title: CANS cross-tool identity
description: Single shared identity file (01a §3.6). One person, one canonical id, per-tool handles (jira, jiraAccountId, confluence, confluenceAccountId, figma). This is the SOLE people store; agents read this file directly. Regenerated by /jira-init from live Atlassian assignees; gitignored. Sync's 'append unknown assignee with empty aliases[]' behaviour appends here, matched on the tool handle (additive, non-destructive).

aliases.description: Convenience aliases for NL queries (resolved locally, never pushed to any tool).

jira.description: JIRA account handle (human-facing, e.g. abbasqa). May be an email-prefix handle for people seeded from live MCP data.

jiraAccountId.description: Stable Atlassian accountId (e.g. 712020:xxxx or 24-hex). This is what MCP search/getIssue return and what alias/who queries resolve against; the 'jira' handle is convenience only.

unresolvedAliasPolicy.description: How an ambiguous/unknown alias is handled. 'ask' triggers a clarifying question rather than a guess (01a §3.3).
